title: The Paladins Omnibus
author: David Dalglish
note: conf=0.93; Collected edition (also sold as "The Paladins 4-Book Bundle" / "The Paladins Collection" / "The Paladins: Books 1-4") containing all four novels of David Dalglish's Paladins series: Night of Wolves (#1, 2011), Clash of Faiths (#2, 2011), The Old Ways (#3, 2011/2012), and The Broken Pieces (#4, 2012). Note the filename abbreviates book 1 as "Night Wolves"; the actual title is "Night of Wolves." Because it is an omnibus spanning volumes 1-4, it has no single series number (Goodreads lists it as The Paladins #1-4). The Paladins is set in Dalglish's wider Dezrel/Half-Orcs universe, but The Paladins is the tight sub-series.
